terminals.name: meilisearch
terminals.description: Full-text search engine. The server rebuilds its index from SQLite on boot, so this data directory is disposable.

terminals.name: backend
terminals.description: Fastify API + cron scheduler on port 3000 with auth disabled (development only). Migrates the SQLite DB and loads demo seed data on first run.

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Vite dev server (HMR) on port 5173, proxying /api to the backend on port 3000.
